note: MECH-A CPU per-part keyframe via the shared mixer (animated_scenery.js:389/495). Zero program links (no shader patch), zero added draw calls (de-instanced rebuild is the SHIPPED tree-wind path, not a delta), zero VRAM. Cost is CPU + the already-paid de-instance, bounded by the 512 cap — NEVER scales with placement count (build-spec §11.3).

MECH-B begin_vertex displace on the COMBINED tip-flex SET clone (getCachedVariant per (surfaceDid,setKey,configKey); SET=[deformation.tipFlex, emissive.glint], ONE program via __vfxSetKey/_patchSetCacheKey). +1 program PER UNIQUE DRIVER (the patch-set link variant) — co-resident with the SET emissive.glint frag entry in the SAME program (vertex begin_vertex seam + frag emissivemap seam compiled together), so the SET adds ONE link, not two; the per-component sum (tipFlex 1 + glint 1) is a conservative UPPER BOUND the gauge tolerates. 0 added draw calls (instancing intact), 0 VRAM (uniform-only: shared uTime oscillator + holding-loc grip frame, no new sampler). Per-instance sway phase rides hash01/aVfxHash, NEVER a uniform baked into the GLSL string (a per-placement uniform forks the program per placement = a hard FAIL, design §2.1). Vertex ALU low (~a few sin/cos). dLightsPerDriver=0 (no light-count relink, G4).

Fragment after <roughnessmap_fragment> / <emissivemap_fragment>; view-sweep glint folds into ONE link variant per material-SET (≤1 program per driver, build-spec §11.3). 0 draw calls, 0 VRAM (no new sampler — drives totalEmissiveRadiance from the existing surface). bloomTier sub (≤0.6, never blooms). Spends the FRAGMENT budget, not a light slot (§10.3).

Fragment after <map_fragment>; modifies resolved diffuseColor.rgb + roughnessFactor only (build-spec §8.2). ≤1 program per material-SET, 0 draw calls. Small VRAM only if the textured (uBlotchMap) link variant is used (uniform-only tarnish is 0 VRAM); per-instance age is a procedural in-shader hash (zero attribute, zero per-instance texture growth). Never writes a per-instance customProgramCacheKey.

Fragment after <emissivemap_fragment>; totalEmissiveRadiance += diffuse*uGlow (reuses the resolved diffuse as emissiveMap — the applyFloatLumDiffuse path materials.js:1238 — so 0 new sampler, 0 VRAM). emissiveIntensity floored ≤2.0. ≤1 link variant per material-SET (build-spec §11.3), 0 draw calls. Bloom halos are free when ?bloom is on (bloom is a GLOBAL post pass, not a per-driver cost). Spends the FRAGMENT budget, never a light slot (dLightsPerDriver=0).

Fragment after <emissivemap_fragment>; totalEmissiveRadiance *= (1 + a*sin(uTime*f + phase)). Phase rides the per-instance hash (vVfxHash), NEVER baked into the GLSL string (a per-placement uniform in the source forks the program per placement = a hard FAIL, §2.1). uTime is the shared VFX_GLOBALS/oscillator uniform (one tick/frame, O(1), placement-independent). ≤1 program per material-SET, 0 draw calls, 0 VRAM.

Global rain sheen — fragment after <map_fragment> (POST-palette decode, [[reference_chorizite_render_semantics]]): darken resolved diffuseColor.rgb + drop roughnessFactor, weighted by world-normal.up * VFX_GLOBALS.uWetness. ONE shared global uniform (weather_inputs.js), applies broadly (not per-DID), composing into the existing material-SET: ≤1 added program per SET, 0 draw calls, 0 VRAM (uniform-only, no new texture). Mutually exclusive with weathering.frost (single diffuse-channel owner per §14).

Winter-zone frost — fragment after <map_fragment> (POST-palette): lighten + desaturate diffuseColor.rgb + micro-sparkle, weighted by world-normal.up * VFX_GLOBALS.uFrost (season/temp, weather_inputs.js). ONE shared global uniform, ≤1 added program per material-SET, 0 draw calls, 0 VRAM. MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE with weathering.wetness (§14 diffuse-channel single-owner) — a driver carries at most one, so the two never double-count a program.

Torch/brazier light whose .intensity jitters via a shared oscillator (smoothNoise/decay) ticked once/frame — NO shader patch (mech=light, not frag): 0 programs, 0 draw calls, 0 VRAM, 0 particle emitters. THE RULE (binding): modulates .intensity ONLY — NEVER .visible or the light array/count (a count change forces a MeshStandard RELINK + frame freeze — the spell-freeze light-pool history). dLightsPerDriver=0 is the G4 invariant (lightCountDelta must stay 0). CPU cost is O(flickering lights), placement-independent.
The no-op fallback (build-spec §3.2). Emits zero components → the statics/scenery bake skips attach → the frozen path is byte-identical. Costs nothing on any axis.

P3.3 — the FIRST particle slice and the FIRST effect on the FILL axis. ONE persistent additive billboard emitter (totalSeconds:0) of 2-4 reused DAT soft-dot sprites at the gem/root anchor. dCallsPerInstance:1 = one additive draw call per emitter (NOT per particle, NOT per placement — the gauge sums per UNIQUE DRIVER, §11.2; the runtime RP6 220 m + frustum cull, maxParticlesPerEmitter 64-2048/quality, and the PlayEffect FIFO bound the concurrent VISIBLE fill). dProgramsPerDriver:0 — no shader patch (mech=particle, like MECH-A: the unlit additive billboard material already exists, materialCache.getParticleUnlit). dVramMB:0 — references an EXISTING sprite gfxobjId, zero new sampler/texture (P3.2). dLightsPerDriver:0 (G4 — purely additive billboard, never a light). costClass medium because particle = the FILL/overdraw axis (design §5.3), categorically above the free-at-steady-state frag/uniform 'cheap' set even though §4.5 annotates gemSparkle's gpuCost as the cheapest WITHIN the particle class. Legacy-safe firewall: writes only the synthesized client-local emitter, deterministic phase from hash01+clock (NEVER Math.random), no wire/collision/replicated state.

P3.6 brazier embers+smoke — TWO synthesized persistent additive/alpha billboard emitters anchored to the flame-bowl part (mech=particle, NO shader patch): 0 programs, 0 VRAM (reuses existing DAT sprite gfxobjs 0x01000FF4 additive + 0x01000FBF alpha — no new sampler/texture), 0 lights (G4). dParticleEmitters:2 + dCallsPerInstance:2 = the FIRST rows with non-zero draw calls (one nominal call per emitter; real per-frame fill is bounded by maxParticlesPerEmitter 64/256/1024/2048 per quality + the RP6 220m+frustum cull, NOT placement count — design §11.2 scaling invariant holds). costClass MEDIUM = additive OVERDRAW/FILL budget axis (§5.3), not particle count. Per-unique-driver (one spec per brazier config), never per placement; variety from hash01+emitter RNG, never a per-instance customProgramCacheKey. NOTE (P3.5): the gauge G2 (drawcallsDelta==0) must become particle-aware BEFORE any particle row is SUMMED by a reference; the Holtburg ref resolves no particle archetype, so this row is gauge-safe today (G2 stays 0).

Low-rate sphere-spread soft-dot motes over the foliage bbox (alpha). 0 programs, 0 VRAM. dCallsPerInstance:1. cheap = low birthrate + small maxParticles; day-gated. Targets foliage NOT claimed by trunk-canopy (small/single-part), so it never composes with the wind path on the same driver.

Additive dusk-gated firefly variant of foliage pollen (same anchor, additive sprite + DUSK visibility gate). 0 programs, 0 VRAM. dCallsPerInstance:1. Provided as the additive sibling of particle.foliagePollen; gated mutually-exclusive by time-of-day so day(pollen)/dusk(firefly) never both render on one driver (no double-count). Not yet bundled into an archetype components[] (agent-10 may split it from foliage-pollen) — present so the gauge has its cost row when wired.

Falling-leaf emitter from the canopy part (emitterType birthrate/sec, flutter velocity, fade-before-ground). 0 programs, 0 VRAM (existing leaf sprite gfxobj). dCallsPerInstance:1. medium = canopy fill on tall trees, cap concurrent. Intended as a COMPOSE modifier on trunk-canopy (the winner-take-all cascade shadows a standalone foliage-leaves stage for wind trees) — gated + budgeted independently of the windBend cost.

Low-rate alpha fog puff from the creature HEAD part via the LIVE entity rig partFrames (world-space → scene-local via _resolveAnchorFrame, the 2026-06-20 fix; do NOT double-apply worldRoot -pi/2 X). 0 programs, 0 VRAM. dCallsPerInstance:1. cheap; COLD-region/season runtime gate. Owner key = entity guid; owner-registry teardown on despawn (never leaks). Excluded for default_script-bearing creature Setups.
